description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油50型混凝土泵的理论输送量印成30 m³/h，把最大出口压力印成30 MPa。输送量是体积流量。压力是同一页上的另一格。标题为「Concrete pump」的画面主体是工人在墙体模板上扶着混凝土输送软管。这一帧没有印出这两格，也不会把别的厂家铭牌抄到这个型号上。

h1.en: How Diesel 50 Concrete Pump Separates Pressure from Output
h1.zh: 柴油50型混凝土泵怎样把压力和输送量分成两格

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 30 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. Output is a volume rate. Pressure is a separate cell on the same sheet. The frame titled “Concrete pump” shows workers guiding a concrete delivery hose on wall formwork. That frame does not print these two cells, and another maker's plate is not copied onto this model.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油50型混凝土泵的理论输送量印成30 m³/h，把最大出口压力印成30 MPa。输送量是体积流量。压力是同一页上的另一格。标题为「Concrete pump」的画面主体是工人在墙体模板上扶着混凝土输送软管。这一帧没有印出这两格，也不会把别的厂家铭牌抄到这个型号上。

body.en: On the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 30 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. A piston pump pushes concrete into the line; a squeeze pump flattens a hose from outside. Either way, m³/h is not MPa. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140. Main Unit Weight 3300 kg.
body.zh: 在柴油50型混凝土泵这一页，理论输送量是30 m³/h，最大出口压力是30 MPa。活塞泵把混凝土推进管路，挤压泵从外面压扁软管。无论哪一种，立方米每小时都不是兆帕。料斗容积 0.4 m³。液压泵 Kawasaki 140。整机重量 3300 kg。

heading.en: What the frame is allowed to show

body.en: The frame comes from en.wikipedia.org, page “Concrete pump”. Its subject is workers guiding a concrete delivery hose on wall formwork. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not treat that caption as a nameplate for the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this sheet.
body.zh: 这一帧来自 en.wikipedia.org 的页面「Concrete pump」。画面主体是工人在墙体模板上扶着混凝土输送软管。河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成柴油50型混凝土泵的铭牌。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: The Xingtai row does not print a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140. Main Unit Weight 3300 kg. Those printed extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 邢台这一行没有印保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。料斗容积 0.4 m³。液压泵 Kawasaki 140。整机重量 3300 kg。这些已印的附加格仍然不是行程。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted.
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有印行程、冲次和价格。
